title: Vanishing Voices: Languages in Danger
shared_passage: Watch a video about languages. For questions 1 to 7, choose the correct answer.

questions.question: The words he mentions at the beginning of the video belong to languages...
options: that might disappear soon.
that were spoken in the past.
that he would like to speak.

questions.question: Which sentence is correct?
options: One out of three languages in the world have fewer than 1,000 speakers.
40% of languages have disappeared.
Over 17,000 languages are spoken in the world.

questions.question: According to the video, Latin...
options: is still spoken today but in different forms.
died over 2,000 ago.
was the first important language to die.

questions.question: The chart shows...
options: languages in danger of extinction.
the languages that are still spoken and extinct languages.
the health of today's languages.

questions.question: In the Soviet Union, ...
options: the government forced the people to speak only Russian.
young people saw how necessary it was to speak Russian.
some people refused to speak Russian.

questions.question: Hebrew...
options: is the official language in more than one country.
is the only dead language that came to life again.
has four million speakers.

questions.question: Cornish is...
options: the second most spoken language in Wales.
a dead language.
a language spoken only by a few.
